samples.question: Gray links meet only at cyan round stations; a crossing without a station is not a connection. A bridge is a gray link whose removal disconnects its panel. Imagine removing every bridge link at once. A loop group is a remaining connected group of stations that contains a loop. Which panel has exactly two loop groups? Answer left, center, or right.
